About Us - FreezPak | A Legacy of Excellence in Cold Storage & Logistics

Logistics Breaking Boundaries

Since 1961, the Saoud family has been an integral part of the food industry, and FreezPak specializes in transforming cold chain logistics with tailored solutions to meet diverse industry needs.

1960s

The Foundation. Ray Saoud Farms began as a local retail store and evolved into a wholesale supplier, laying the foundation for future growth and expansion.

1970s

Expansion and Diversification. Characterized by significant infrastructure developments and diversification into the frozen food sector, this decade broadened the company’s market reach and capabilities.

1990s

Family Involvement. Focus shifted to preparing the next generation for leadership, ensuring the family legacy would continue with strong and experienced successors.

2000s

Rebirth and Growth. Marked the rebirth of the business under the new name FreezPak Logistics, accompanied by significant expansion and infrastructure development.

2010s

Technological Advancement and Expansion. Technological advancements with the adoption of hydrogen infrastructure and significant geographic and capacity expansions defined this period.

2020s

Nationwide Expansion and Recognition. A period of aggressive nationwide expansion, environmental commitment through solar power, and significant recognition for the leadership team.

FreezPak offers full cold storage solutions, merging warehousing and logistics for efficient supply chain management. Established in 1960, the Saoud family, known for swift distribution, entered cold storage logistics in 2001. Celebrated as the fastest cold storage shipper globally, FreezPak maintains optimal temperature conditions with cutting-edge technology, preserving product quality during storage.

- Strategic Locations

With strategically located facilities, we offer convenient access to major transportation hubs, facilitating swift and cost-effective distribution of goods. All facilities are in the heavyweight corridor and are located within a 25-mile radius of the port, facilitating access for FDA inspections.
- Proven Expertise

With decades of experience in the industry, FreezPak has honed its expertise in handling various products, including perishables and frozen items. Our seasoned team understands the nuances of temperature-sensitive logistics, ensuring the safe storage and transportation of your goods.
- Flexibility and Scalability

FreezPak understands that businesses evolve, and we offer flexible solutions that can be tailored to your specific needs. Whether you're a small business or a large enterprise, our scalable services can accommodate your growth.
- Innovative Technology

Embracing the latest advancements, FreezPak integrates innovative technologies to enhance operational efficiency. This includes real-time tracking, inventory management systems, and automated processes.
- Customer-Centric Approach

At FreezPak, we prioritize customer satisfaction . Our dedicated customer support team ensures clear communication and responsiveness, addressing your concerns promptly.
- Cost-Effective Solutions

We are committed to delivering value for your investment. Our streamlined processes and efficient operations contribute to cost savings, making FreezPak a cost-effective choice for your cold storage needs.
- Sustainability Initiatives

FreezPak is conscious of environmental impact. We incorporate sustainable practices in our operations, aligning with eco-friendly standards and minimizing our carbon footprint. Investments in hydrogen, water recapture, and solar technologies align with companies in their pursuit of achieving net carbon neutrality by the year 2050.
- Recognition and Awards

Our commitment to excellence has earned the founders accolades, including being named Entrepreneur of the Year in New Jersey by Ernst and Young. This recognition underlines our dedication to delivering outstanding cold storage services.

CASE STUDY: FREEZPAK  |  1

## THE SITUATION

FreezPak’s New Jersey facilities operate “around-the-clock” five to seven days a week, focusing on delivering products to market efficiently with industry-leading quality. Cold storage and freezer facilities are tough on batteries. Before FreezPak switched to fuel cells, lift operators were required to take multiple fifteen minute breaks each morning and afternoon as well as using their lunchtime to fast-charge the forklift batteries. This was necessary to complete each ten-hour work shift. The drooping batteries meant they had to choose between full power for moving product and heat for their backrests. The cold sapped both the battery power and staff morale.

Co-owners Michael and David Saoud and Operations Manager, Phil DeMedici searched for a solution that would improve operations productivity and predictability as well as conditions for their workers. If it was easy on the environment, even better. When FreezPak was introduced to Plug Power’s GenDrive hydrogen fuel cells, they found the solution they were after, quickly implementing fuel cells and hydrogen into their forklift truck fleets.

“We move 40% more volume during a 9-hour shift with fuel cells than we did with batteries,” said Phil DeMedici. “And our drivers are happier because they can do their jobs efficiently and comfortably.”

## THE POWER PLAYERS

### CASE STUDY: FreezPak Logistics

FreezPak is a leading New Jersey-based frozen food distributor. For over 50 years Saoud Enterprises, owner and operator of FreezPak, has been faithfully and proudly serving the food industry, making FreezPak one of the leading full-service cold and dry storage facilities in the United States.

## POWERING POSSIBILITIES

In its Carteret, New Jersey facility, FreezPak deployed Plug Power’s full service GenKey bundle, including more than 40 Plug Power GenDrive fuel cells, replacing batteries in lift vehicles. Support for the fuel cell systems includes GenFuel outdoor hydrogen storage with two indoor GenFuel dispensers, and GenCare service for the fuel cells and hydrogen system.

FreezPak’s Paterson, NJ facility, uses 9 GenDrive fuel cells, while utilizing Plug Power’s GenFuel “hub and spoke” model. This innovative hydrogen distribution solution provides fuel from the Carteret facility to the Paterson facility, spreading the fueling cost across both facilities. FreezPak operators refuel the lift trucks themselves in just minutes at strategically placed GenFuel dispensers inside the warehouse. As an industry leader, FreezPak is empowered by its GenKey installation, improving productivity and output for each shift by as much as 40%, streamlining their material handling processes and improving product speed to market.

FreezPak is committed to adopting sustainable solutions that allow it to enhance operations and successfully compete with other cold storage service providers. Through the adoption of hydrogen fuel cells, FreezPak has presented itself as a pioneer in the cold storage market and has already received awards for innovation within the material handling market.

“Our customers look to us for progressive technology,” commented Michael Saoud.

## WHY PLUG POWER & HYDROGEN FUEL CELLS

Productivity Enhancements Save Money. Battery charging in the cold warehouse environment was costing FreezPak 1 hour per shift compared to two minutes for hydrogen refueling. Over one year, that 58 minutes per shift time savings represented over 590 hours of lost productivity per forklift truck in a two-shift operation. Fuel cells store enough hydrogen to complete a standard eight- to 10-hour shift.

Additionally, FreezPak was able to lower their electric bills by 31.5% after the switch to fuel cells. With hydrogen fuel cells, cold chain facilities can eliminate battery rooms, putting both space and capital dollars into business-enhancing activities.

Consistent Power Even in the Freezer. Unlike batteries, hydrogen-powered forklift trucks operate at full power all shift long, even in the most extreme conditions as low as -22 degrees F. With batteries, FreezPak’s turret truck operators were having to choose not to use their headlights and cab and backrest heaters in order to conserve battery. Imagine driving a car all day in winter without a working heater. The switch to fuel cells not only allows operators to stay productive longer, but also means lift truck operators can remain comfortable and safe in the cold storage facility for a full shift.

Clean Energy is Safe Energy. Hydrogen fuel cells provide a clean, zero-emission power solution that boosts productivity and reduces greenhouse gases. Fuel cells contain no toxic materials and only emit heat and water as byproducts. No battery acid, no crushed fingers, no electrical shocks . Instead, warehouse operations that move smoothly with predictable speed. Fuel cells are safe for employees, clean for the community, and mean better business for customers.

“I would never go back to batteries,” said David Saoud. “The case for fuel cells in freezer warehouses is too strong.”

Mike Saoud | ACG New Jersey

# Mike Saoud 

 

Co-Founder | Co-Chief Executive Officer

Freezpak Logistics

Mike, a Kean University graduate with a degree in business, co-founded FreezPak Logistics in 2001 alongside his brother, Dave Saoud. Currently serving as the Co-CEO, Mike has propelled FreezPak beyond its origins as a third-party food logistics company, offering an array of services encompassing transportation and temperature-controlled solutions. His leadership has steered the company into the realms of automation and IT innovation.

Incorporating robotics into FreezPak's operations, Mike spearheaded the deployment of 131 robots in various markets around the United States. As the driving force behind warehouse operations, he takes a strategic approach to introduce new software technology, aiming to enhance overall efficiency within the organization.

Dave Saoud | ACG New Jersey

# Dave Saoud 

 

Co-Founder | Co-Chief Executive Officer

Freezpak Logistics

Dave is the Co-Founder/CEO of FreezPak Logistics, a 3rd party food logistics company that offers a variety of services from transportation to temperature-controlled solutions. His vision and dedication have shaped the company into a leading third-party food logistics provider.

Dave's journey began with academic excellence, graduating cum laude from Seton Hall University with a business management degree. Leveraging this knowledge, he co-founded FreezPak Logistics in 2001 alongside his brother Mike Saoud.

Today, Dave plays a multifaceted role within FreezPak. He oversees the strategic direction of sales operations and transportation, ensuring efficient customer service and product movement. His commitment goes beyond everyday tasks; Dave champions the enhancement of end-to-end business solutions for FreezPak's clients, tailoring services to their specific needs.

Furthermore, Dave's influence extends to the physical landscape of FreezPak. He directs the site selection, design of company buildings, ensuring functionality and supporting future growth. This focus on strategic expansion reflects Dave's commitment to fostering the FreezPak brand as a leader in the food logistics industry.
